difficulty_reason: For a representable transformation of functors on the fppf site, the lemma records that smoothness, etaleness and unramifiedness imply the corresponding formal properties. The proof reduces each statement to the corresponding statement about the representing morphisms of schemes and then applies the schemes-side results. The reduction through representability is the content. Retained author proof at lines 2540-2564.
